items.title: Jimmy Cobb — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Al Cohn and Zoot Sims. We made a couple trips with them. They just put us with everybody like that.

ctx.x: Al Cohn and Zoot Sims. We made a couple trips with them. They just put us with everybody like that. We did some – what else did we do? We just did a lot of record dates with people. In fact we did one record date, I think, that had Berry Gordy before he really got into his soul thing. We did – I remember – I don’t remember hearing it. I don’t even know if it got put out, or they threw it out, or what, because we weren’t doing what he expected or what he probably turned out to do later, with Reba and all those…
